units.unit_name: Module 1: Basic Concepts of Linear Algebra

topics.description: An overview of fundamental concepts in linear algebra.
Understanding the properties of positive definite matrices.
Exploration of quadratic forms and their applications.
Introduction to SVD and its significance in dimensionality reduction.
Methods for solving least squares problems.
Applying linear algebra concepts to linear modeling.
Techniques for PCA and its applications in data analysis.
Graphical methods for solving linear optimization problems.
Detailed study of the simplex algorithm for optimization.

topics.topic_name: Integer programming problems - branch and bound method
topics.description: Techniques for solving integer programming problems.
Understanding duality in optimization and issues of degeneracy.
Fundamental concepts of vector calculus relevant to optimization.
Exploration of non-linear optimization without constraints.
Application of Newton's method for optimization problems.
Techniques for finding local minima using descent methods.
Understanding the role of the derivative matrix in optimization.
Concepts of level sets and their significance in optimization.

topics.topic_name: Non-Linear constrained optimization problems - Lagrange multiplier method
topics.description: Application of Lagrange multipliers in constrained optimization.

topics.topic_name: Applications of Quadratic forms in constrained optimization
topics.description: Using quadratic forms in the context of constrained optimization.
